commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
90+2' 1 - 2 Goal - 1:2! Tijjani Noslin (Lazio) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top right corner. Boulaye Dia provided an assist for the goal.
90+1' Adam Marusic (Lazio) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.

88' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nuno Tavares (Lazio) was quite harsh and Daniele Chiffi didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
87' Neat passing move from Lazio in order to create new attacking opportunities.

52' The resulting corner from Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese) is cleared.

8' Daniele Chiffi interrupts the game. One of the players from Lazio won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
